title: Launch Checklist
description: A launch is a matrix of platforms × timing × assets (Levels, *MAKE* 2018): the same product launches repeatedly, on many platforms, each with its own timing norms and asset requirements — launching is a process, not an event. Per-bet artifact (`bets/<bet-id>/launch-checklist.json` or the target repo's docs/), stamped by CW as part of the channel-engine asset layer (chief-wiggum#241 leg 2): CW generates everything up to the post — the operator posts. Listing/launch platforms here are distinct from acquisition channels (channels.json): a launch usually feeds the `existing-platforms` or `public-relations` channel experiment, and results should be recorded there.

product.description: Product/bet this checklist launches. One checklist per launch wave.

bet_id.description: Portfolio bet this launch belongs to, if any — results feed that bet's channel experiments.

platform.description: Launch surface — e.g. product-hunt, hacker-news, reddit-<sub>, x-twitter, linkedin, indie-hackers, betalist, dev-to, lobsters, a niche directory, a newsletter, the GPT store. Free string: launch surfaces churn, unlike the fixed 19 acquisition channels.

timing.description: Platform-specific timing norms (day-of-week and hour materially move results on PH/HN).

planned_date.description: ISO date of the planned post.

time_utc.description: Planned post time, UTC (e.g. 07:01 for Product Hunt).

rationale.description: Why this slot — the platform's timing norm being followed.

assets.description: Everything that must exist before posting. CW stamps/generates these; the operator reviews and posts.

type.description: Asset kind — e.g. tagline, title, first-comment, screenshot, gif, demo-video, maker-story, faq, landing-copy, og-image.

path.description: Where the asset lives (repo path or URL).

status.description: `posted` is the operator's act — the tooling generates everything up to it, never substitutes for it.

result_note.description: What happened (rank, upvotes, signups, conversations started). Quantified acquisition results belong on the channel experiment this launch fed.
